## ekomex Konstanz, introductory course (online)

### Introduction to AI-assisted text analysis

| | |
|:--|:--|
| **When** | February 18–19, 2027 |
| **Where** | Online ([Konstanz Methods Excellence Workshops, University of Konstanz](https://afww.uni-konstanz.de/en/microcredential-ekomex-introduction-ai-assisted-text-analysis)) |
| **Format** | Two-day hands-on workshop with synchronous labs, office hours and small-group work (1 ECTS) |
| **Registration** | 250 EUR (early bird 180 EUR) — [register here](https://afww.uni-konstanz.de/en/microcredential-ekomex-introduction-ai-assisted-text-analysis) |

This workshop introduces AI-assisted text analysis in R with open-source and closed LLMs, using the **quallmer** package for classification, validation and reproducible workflows. Designed for PhD students; beginners in R are welcome.

**Instructor:** [Seraphine F. Maerz](https://seraphinem.github.io/)

.workshop-downloads { display: none; }
.workshop-downloads.visible { display: block; }
.workshop-error {
  color: #dc3545;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  display: none;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}
.workshop-error.visible { display: block; }
</style>

<script>
function checkWorkshopPassword(id, password) {
  var entered = document.getElementById(id + '-password').value;
  var downloads = document.getElementById(id + '-downloads');
  var error = document.getElementById(id + '-error');
  var form = document.getElementById(id + '-form');

  if (entered === password) {
    downloads.classList.add('visible');
    form.style.display = 'none';
    error.classList.remove('visible');
  } else {
    error.classList.add('visible');
  }
}
</script>
